messages:
priya: running the scheduled restore drill for tenant-42 — hit a decrypt failure during the final step, looks like KMS grant denied on the restore role
priya: error snippet: `AccessDeniedException: Encrypt/Decrypt denied for key arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd`
derek: did the CMK rotate during the window? we ran a rotation last night but grants should have been re-propagated
lee: i pulled audit logs — there's an `iam:PassRole` change for `restore-runner` at 02:12 UTC. possible RBAC rule tightened by recent least-privilege PR
katie: copying the PR link: https://git.redd/infrastructure/pulls/412 — it scoped `restore-runner` to a narrower role for snapshots
priya: aha, that PR removed `kms:Decrypt` on the role for snapshot-downloads, it was supposed to be replaced by an ephemeral grant flow but the rotation test didn't wire the grant step
derek: so chain is: CMK rotated -> grant service should issue CreateGrant for role -> restore uses grant to decrypt -> missing grant == AccessDenied. makes sense
lee: sec-bot flagged ephemeral grant service failing retries around 02:10 UTC with `504` from kms-proxy. sounds like transient but we never rollback perms
oncall-sre: we should treat this as a drill incident. escalate to ops for immediate runbook test. tagging @oncall-sre
priya: agreed — immediate actions: 1) re-run grant issuance manually for the affected key 2) retry restore 3) collect audit logs for postmortem
katie: manual grant command I used in test: `aws kms create-grant --key-id <key-id> --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123:role/restore-runner --operations Decrypt`
lee: after manual grant restore succeeded. can confirm snapshot restored to staging, integrity checks passed :white_check_mark:
derek: follow-up items: add a short-circuit check in rotation: sanity-verify that CreateGrant completed and an example decrypt returns 200 before finalizing rotation
priya: and add alerting: if ephemeral-grant-service returns 5xx x3 within 5m during a rotation, mark rotation as failed and auto-rollback CMK state or pause deploy
oncall-sre: also need a one-time remediation to scan other recent rotations (past 72h) for missing grants; I'll open a ticket
lee: audit log query I used: `fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.principalId, requestParameters.keyId | filter eventName = "CreateGrant" and requestParameters.keyId = "<key-id>"`
derek: note for RBAC: restore-runner now needs to be explicitly allowed to use grants, update docs and SOPs — remove implicit assumptions
katie: i'll draft a short postmortem blurb and a follow-up checklist (grant service retries, rotation gating, runbook update)
priya: thanks team. filing postmortem and linking runbook: https://confluence/redwood/sec/restore-kms-rotation-drill
sec-bot: Incident drill recorded (id=drill-2026-03-21-01). Remind: attach logs and snapshots to ticket for retention
priya: leaving this thread open for 24h, will update ticket with timelines and RCA once we have full log collection
